name: Indigo-Stats
description: Indigo Stats is a private air-quality and weather dashboard for a PurpleAir sensor on your local network. It collects readings every minute, keeps long-term history on your Unraid server, and presents current conditions and trends in a responsive web app that can be installed as a PWA.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent SQLite database and local snapshots. Keep this directory when updating or replacing the container. Use local SSD-backed appdata, not SMB/NFS.

paths.name: Offsite backup mount
paths.description: Optional host directory or mounted NFS/SMB share for off-server backups. Must be a distinct mount from /data.

ports.name: Web UI port
ports.description: HTTP port on the trusted LAN. Use a private HTTPS proxy for mobile PWA installation. The application has no login.

variables.name: PurpleAir sensor IP
variables.description: Private LAN IPv4 address of the PurpleAir device. Reserve its DHCP address. The app does not scan the subnet.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone for charts, such as America/Los_Angeles or Europe/London.

variables.name: PM2.5 method
variables.description: cf1 preserves the raw channel-average PM2.5. epa2021 applies the US outdoor correction using raw humidity.

variables.name: Temperature and humidity
variables.description: purpleair matches PurpleAir estimated ambient layers. raw shows operating sensor readings. simple applies -8 F and +4 humidity points. Raw values are always retained.

variables.name: Enable regional forecasts
variables.description: Enable only after supplying both coordinates. Coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for regional weather and PM2.5 forecasts.

variables.name: Forecast latitude
variables.description: Optional private latitude from -90 to 90. Enter both coordinates or leave both blank.

variables.name: Forecast longitude
variables.description: Optional private longitude from -180 to 180. Coordinates are not returned by browser APIs.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UID used by the application after startup. Unraid nobody is normally 99.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GID used by the application after startup. Unraid users is normally 100.

variables.name: Google OAuth Client ID
variables.description: Optional Google OAuth 2.0 Web Client ID for Google Drive backups.

variables.name: Google OAuth Client Secret
variables.description: Optional Google OAuth 2.0 Client Secret for Google Drive backups.

variables.name: Google OAuth Callback URI
variables.description: Optional exact OAuth callback URI registered in Google Cloud Console (e.g. https://your-domain/api/backups/google/callback).

variables.name: S3 Access Key ID
variables.description: Optional AWS or S3-compatible Access Key ID for off-server backups.

variables.name: S3 Secret Access Key
variables.description: Optional AWS or S3-compatible Secret Access Key for off-server backups.
